source: async function runReviewedCompany(name,rank=0){const W=eval(load("internationalHelpers"));const result=await eval(load("runInternationalSource"))(name,rank);const card=load("internationalCurrent");const meta=[load("atsCurrent"),load("ghCurrent")].find(m=>m?.url===card.href);if(result!==true&&meta){const c=await W.ev("tab_i","({url:location.href,text:document.body.innerText})");if(c.url.startsWith(card.href.split('?')[0])&&/\\nSuccess\\n|successfully submitted|application.*received|Thank you for applying|Thanks for applying/i.test(c.text)){await W.record(meta,c);return true;}}return result;}runReviewedCompany
